start: owner in the admin app, Help and feedback, the gym has AI credits

steps.action: Type 'How do I add a member?' and tap 'Send'
user_sees: A short answer written from the help articles
must_not: An answer that quotes gym or member records
A wrong gym charged
The message lost when the answer is slow

steps.action: Tap 'Yes' under 'Did this solve it?'
must_not: The tap saved twice
Another person's question rated

steps.action: Look at the AI credit use in the panel
user_sees: no gym credit is used (staff questions are free, with a daily limit)
must_not: A credit taken when the AI did not answer

start: owner asks a question when the gym has no credits left or the day's AI questions are used

steps.action: Type the question and tap 'Send'
user_sees: The matching help pages and a line saying why the AI was not asked
must_not: A credit taken
An empty answer

start: owner asked a question yesterday; the MettleUp team has replied

steps.action: Open Help and feedback again
user_sees: The question with the AI answer and the team's reply, oldest reply first
must_not: Another install's questions
A reply shown under the wrong question

start: owner in the admin app, Help and feedback

steps.action: Tap 'Send' with an empty box
must_not: An AI call made

steps.action: Tap 'Did this solve it?' a second time after answering
must_not: The rating changed silently

steps.action: Send 21 questions in one day
user_sees: 'Too many messages today. Try again tomorrow.'
must_not: An AI answer for a refused question

start: owner asked a question and the AI failed to answer

steps.action: Tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message and reply as soon as we can.'
must_not: A credit kept for a question with no AI answer
The question lost

steps.action: A day later the team replies, then replies again
must_not: Only the newest reply in a new app

start: owner asked a question

steps.action: The question goes to the AI
must_not: The gym code, install id, phone model or any gym record sent to the AI

steps.action: Another phone asks for replies with a guessed id
must_not: This person's question or reply shown on another phone
